observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a theater stage with a backdrop projection and live musicians playing on stage
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women of various ages
observation.formation_and_space: groups in lines, pairs, and circle formations travelling across the stage

observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stamping and shuffling steps closely following the rapid tempo; specific subtle weight transfers cannot be verified from the video resolution

observation.partnering: pairs holding hands and briefly embracing or dancing face-to-face
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing levels with continuous footwork and circular partner turns

women holding and fluttering their colorful skirts in a circle
couples paired up dancing and turning in circles while moving across the stage
